source.description: Element wildcard processing and xsi:type assessment are separate from namespace matching. Known types validate their content and required uses; skip suppresses schema assessment throughout the subtree. Lax fallback still assesses declared descendants. This entrypoint instead demands the declaration.

A selected type never changes the wildcard namespace constraint. The allowed namespace control deliberately has invalid integer text to prove skip processing.

The selected restricted or extended simple-content complex type owns required/prohibited attribute uses and integer facets. An explicit base-type control admits the removed optional attribute and value11, distinguishing selection from schema admission.

An unconstrained union accepts its list member and restrictions of that member through cos-st-derived-ok2.2.4. A list item type is neither a restriction of the list nor a member of this union. Restriction blocking rejects member selection but does not reject identity.

source.description: QName interpretation uses the default namespace of each element start. A sibling namespace reset cannot reuse the preceding unprefixed type resolution; an explicit prefix remains valid and actual-type facets still apply. A child reset is popped before the next sibling.
